name: Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward, and hands clasped in front of your chest or on your hips.
Take a wide step straight out to one side, push your hips back, and bend the stepping knee while keeping your trailing leg completely straight.
Lower until your stepping thigh approaches parallel to the floor with both feet flat and toes pointing forward.
Push powerfully off your stepping foot to return to center, then step to the opposite side, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your weight across the whole stepping foot and let that knee track in line with your toes.
Keep your chest lifted and your trailing foot planted flat on the floor.
